notes: 20 modules — 10 FIT + 10 FIGHT (one pair per stage), dual-path campaign (each stage runs as FIT, FIGHT, or BOTH). APPLIES THE ARCADE SESSION STANDARD (specs/27, data/arcade-session-standards.json): FIT modules carry a counted `prescription` (sets x reps/sec + category + tier); stored numbers are the NORMAL 'MARTIAL MONSTER' baseline, the app re-resolves easy/hard from the volume ladder by tier+category. FIGHT modules carry `round_source`, a `canonical_map` (thematic drill -> canonical discipline + move), a per-round `combo_spec` seeding the live combo generator, and a `finishers` block (explosive bodyweight, capped, counting toward the plyo cap). Tier map: T1 stages 1-2, T2 3-5, T3 6-8, T4 9-10 — stage 9 is a DELOAD (doses kept deliberately light, no tier ladder). Fields: plyo {foot_contact_cap,set_reps,rest_sec,min_recovery_between_plyo_h,amplitude} on plyometric work (NEVER above the beginner cap); sprint_session on sprint work (full recovery); striking_rounds/round_len on fight rounds; medball on throw work. Numbers shown are the NORMAL 'MARTIAL MONSTER' baseline; Easy/Hard scale via campaign.difficulty_scaling. SAFETY (from the report + convention): warm up first incl. shoulders/wrists for striking; plyo 60-100 beginner contacts, 48h moderate / 72h high recovery, no back-to-back plyo; train striking for SPEED not max force (one-punch power is not trainable); wrap hands + gloves for bag work, progressive contact, wrist aligned; contrast training advanced-only (Stage 8). Every module opens with a warm-up and stops on any pain flag (esp. wrist/shoulder) or safety stop criterion. Voice guidance (campaign.voice_guidance) speaks every movement, combination, count, and cue aloud — no reading required.

both_rules.description: When a stage is run as BOTH (fit + fight combined).
both_rules.sequencing: Skill/fight first while fresh, then fit. All 10 stages are single-session dual-path, so BOTH runs fight -> fit back-to-back.
both_rules.shared_plyo_cap: The campaign plyo foot-contact cap is counted ACROSS the whole session — fight finishers + fit explosive share it; if combined would exceed it, the fit explosive block trims first.
both_rules.volume_sanity: In a BOTH session, fit accessory volume may drop one notch so two full high-volume blocks aren't stacked.
both_rules.readiness: A BOTH day is a HARD day: readiness gate applies before starting, and it won't schedule back-to-back with another hard day.
both_rules.announcer: States the combined plan up front (e.g. 'Stage 4: Dutch Rhythm. Fight — 4 rounds. Then Fit — Explosive Bodyweight Circuit, 5 workouts.').

modules.title: Lean Base + Core

prescription.note: 8/side, unilateral — tuned below the squat ladder

modules.coach_note: Build and preserve the muscle that makes a lean look possible. HONESTY: abs come from whole-body fat loss (diet + energy balance), not ab exercises — spot reduction is a myth. Warm the shoulders before any pressing.

clean mechanics — reset to guard after every combo

hands back the instant the shot lands
loose and light — this is not a war

modules.coach_note: Stance, guard, jab, cross — the alphabet of striking. Relaxed and clean beats hard and sloppy. Wrap hands + gloves for any bag contact; keep the wrist straight. Technique content is conventional coaching (not research-graded).

modules.coach_note: Jump rope is the evidence-backed minimal-gear plyo substitute and builds the fast-hands engine. Count contacts, STOP at the cap, land soft. Shadowbox rounds keep it moving while the legs recover. Not on back-to-back days with other plyo.

combo_spec.emphasis: snap the jab, do not push it
the classic one-two-three
move the head, then answer
speed, not force
hit, then get off the line

modules.coach_note: Speed comes from staying loose — snap and relax, don't muscle it. Voice calls the combos out loud so you never read. Train fast hands, not max force.

Sprint intervals
prescription.note: 40-60 m per rep — see sprint_session; FULL recovery between reps

prescription.name: Split-squat / lunge strength
prescription.note: 8/side, unilateral — tuned below the squat ladder

modules.coach_note: Lower-body force is the real driver of punch power (research) — this is the punch behind the punch. Full recovery between sprints and jumps; quality over volume.

modules.title: The Power Shot (Leg Drive)
exercises: Rear-hand cross — drive from the back foot/hip

canonical_map.drill: Rear-hand cross — drive from the back foot/hip

combo_spec.emphasis: drive from the back foot — one shot, full intent

turn the hip all the way through
bend the knees — do not reach down with the arm
power, then reset. never head-hunt

modules.coach_note: Power is a whole-body chain from the floor up — not arm strength. Commit, then reset. FANTASY FLAG: a real 'one-punch' knockout isn't a trainable stat; explosive, well-placed shots are. Keep the wrist aligned on contact.

modules.coach_note: The explosive bodyweight work that pairs with striking — burpees, tuck jumps, side lunges. Jumps count toward the plyo cap; land soft. Capped output, not AMRAP-to-failure.

punches into kicks — one rhythm

modules.coach_note: Dutch style = boxing-forward combos that end on kicks. Turn the hip and land shin-first on the roundhouse; check the wrist on the hands. On a bag, build kick contact gradually. Conventional coaching content.

modules.coach_note: Resilient shoulders let you throw punches for years — rear-delt/cuff and scapular work protect the joint. Dense arms come from progressive rows/chin-ups + push variations. Rotator-cuff protocol is conventional practice, not research-graded here.

modules.coach_note: Wing Chun's fast straight punches down the centerline — relaxed, rapid, structured. Trapping is drilled solo here (real trapping needs a partner). Presented as traditional/conventional method; evidence for specific WC claims is limited — train it for speed and structure.

modules.coach_note: Power-endurance = keeping bursts fast and sharp as you tire (this IS trainable — unlike max one-punch force). Short explosive bursts, then relax. Voice calls each burst so you never read.
